versions.changelog: 21/8: Renset — x402 pay-per-call FJERNET. 100% lokal analyse, ingen netværkskald, ingen API-nøgle
21/8: Sikkerhedsfix — X402_BASE env-override, verificeret TLS, ALLOW_HTTP opt-in, ingen hardcoded IP

- Removed the "Support the builders" section from the documentation.
- All main features, usage instructions, and security notes remain unchanged.

- Added a new "Support the builders" section highlighting Northcap Group, donation options, and ways to participate as a USDC provider or API tester.
- Provided links and brief instructions for registration, donation, and finding related skills.
- No changes to commands or core functionality.

- Removed obsolete documentation file: skill-card.md.
- Updated scripts/x402_client.py (specific code changes not detailed).
- No changes to usage or user-facing features.
SECURITY (SkillSpector): fastlåst base-URL — X402_BASE/API_BASE env-override fjernet (ingen taint-flow til urlopen). Cert-logik rettet til system-CA.
Security: HTTPS-gate (X402_ALLOW_HTTP opt-in) + permissions-metadata deklareret + engelske strenge
Sikkerhedsfix: HTTPS-krav (TT3) — API-nøgle sendes aldrig over HTTP medmindre X402_ALLOW_HTTP=1; X402_BASE dokumenteret; urlencode + User-Agent

- Initial release of drt-market-lens.
- Hent live markedsdata (1h-klines) og ICT-bias for 17 instrumenter, inkl. aktieindeks, valuta, metaller og kryptovalutaer.
- Integration med x402 pay-per-call API for adgang til data.
- Understøtter premium/discount-zoner og SMA50/200 i bias-analyser.
